title: Rate Relationships
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
Rate Relationships

The relationship between basic rates and conditional rates is defined using the rate relationship category:

e Inthe case of the rate relationship category Supplement, the conditional rate is executed in addition to the basic rate.

e Inthe case of the rate relationship category Substitute, the basic rate processes the result of the TOU interface without the
TOU exception period. Instead, the system executes the TOU interface of the conditional rate for the TOU exception period.
The result is processed in the rate steps for the conditional rate.

Therefore, the basic rate is executed in normal TOU periods and for the rate relationship Supplement during TOU exception
periods.

The conditional rate is only executed during TOU exception periods.

The following table provides an overview of the options for combining and using TOU rates and RTP rates as basic and conditional
rates. TOU and RTP rates refer to rates that can be used for interval meters and that belong to RTP billing category EDM Profile
Values, Bill External Profile Values Using TOU Interface (= TOU rate), or Bill EDM Profile Values Using RTP Interface (= RTP rate).

Combination Options

"Substitute"                             "Supplement"
TOU rate                               TOU rate                               yf                                     a
RTP rate                                    RTP rate                                    yf                                           yf
TOU rate                              RTP rate                              ae                                     ae
RTP rate                                  TOU rate                                   ag                                          a
Other rate                                Fact/device rate                         ae                                          yf
Other rate                                Register rate (discrete meter         a                                          4
reading)
Key:

e TOU rate = Rate permissible for interval meters and belonging to RTP billing category Bill EDM Profile Values Using TOU
Interface or Bill External Profile Values Using TOU Interface.

e RTP rate = Rate permissible for interval meters and belonging to RTP billing category Bill EDM Profiles Using RTP
Interface.

e = Combination possible

e 3¢ = Combination not possible
Suppress Proration
This indicator controls proration of the assigned basic rate.

If this indicator is selected, the system does not prorate the basic rate.
